title: Qday
wikitext:
Qday was a gaming LAN party series in the Netherlands. Organized by the group that held the "Bizarre" [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demoscene demoscene] events. The series ended after 3 iterations in 1998. 
The event was held over multiple days in a weekend (as is still common for demoscene events).
